extracted.name: 10-Minute Tomato Basil Salad
extracted.description: This tomato basil salad, made with juicy tomatoes and fresh basil, is dressed with a simple vinaigrette for a quick, flavor-packed summer side dish.
ingredient_lines: 1.5 teaspoons red wine vinegar, or to taste
1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine tomato, basil, olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl; toss until evenly coated.
